name: m1_E_resB0_loomse
declared: D20c diagnostic: m1_E_resB0 re-fitted with lambda chosen by the closed-form leave-one(-patient)-out MSE of y, each gene scaled by its training variance (mean over the group's genes) instead of the LOO Pearson r of record (lambda still shared within the training-fold gene groups variable / other; same grid 1e2..1e7, 16 points). DESIGN §4 rule vs m1_E_resB0 (paired fold-wise dP1 on dev-wide variable genes > 0.005 and > 1 fold SE). If it clears the rule it is treated like D14 (dev-CV model selection; test still blind); otherwise it is reported as robustness only. Also reported: lambda per group and fold, and P1 by training-fold gene-SD decile (all eval genes) vs m1_E_resB0.
